issue: reference builds llama3 inv_freq in fp64, HF in fp32, so an atol 1e-9 equality on values spanning 1.0 to 3e-7 fails
fix: compare at fp32 relative resolution and pin the cos/sin gap to the fp32 angle ulp instead

issue: tt_transformers precompute_freqs forms position*inv_freq in fp32, so its cos/sin differ from an fp64 reference by 3e-4 in the fast columns
fix: bounded the gap by the fp32 angle ulp per column; later gave both sides one shared fp64 frequency source

issue: borrowed KV cache allocates per-chip dim1=1, encoding the sources' one KV head per chip; Llama has 8 kv heads at tp=4
fix: allocate dim1 = num_kv_heads // tp (2) and assert the chunk's head count matches the cache's

issue: gpt-oss/M3 swigluoai scores 0.955 against Llama's silu-swiglu on random data, clearing pcc_lower_bound 0.85
fix: wrote the activation fresh and restated the negative control as two absolute bounds tied to pcc_target

issue: DeepSeek golden-cache helpers take a variant object and name their payload slots for MLA (ref_kvpe_list)
fix: imported the helpers unchanged and adapted at the edges: a SimpleNamespace variant and a stacked [k,v] payload

why: checkpoint is unquantized bf16 with no quantization_config, so there is no dequantization to verify; replaced by test_weight_loader.py

issue: fp16 relative resolution is 2^-11 only where fp16 is normal; the rescaled slow rope frequencies are subnormal and shift by up to 5%
fix: asserted the accumulated phase error (position times delta_inv) instead of the relative frequency shift

issue: golden trace layer-0 K only reaches 0.9860 at 10240 tokens, degrading monotonically with position while V is exact
fix: root-caused to fp16-rounded rope inverse frequencies in the trace generator; reproducing them gives PCC 1.000000
